title: Raj and the Jam Jug
lines: Raj had a job. He got the jam.
Mom had buns. The jam was in a jug.
Raj runs to Mom. He has the big jug.
The jug tips! Jam is on his cap.
"Look at the jam," said Raj. He was sad.
But Raj gets a rag and rubs the cap.
"Raj did a big job," said Mom.
Raj has a jam bun and a big hug.

questions.ask: What was Raj carrying to Mom?
questions.listenFor: The big jug of jam. Lines two and three say it. Let your child reread rather than being told.

questions.ask: Who got the jam off the cap?
questions.listenFor: Raj did, with a rag. Line six says it. If they say Mom, ask them to find the line with the rag in it.

questions.ask: Raj was sad, and then he was not. What do you think changed? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: There is no wrong answer. You are listening for a reason from the story, like he fixed the cap himself.
